thread:
ashley: Heads-up postmortem follow-up for the cache-eviction cascade this morning. Need owners for external comms + a short redaction checklist before anything goes public. I'll propose owners/ETAs below. Please claim or suggest changes by EOD.

tom: thanks. Can we include an explicit estimate for when the RCA will be published? customers keep asking for dates.

ashley: yes. strawman: status page update within 2h, customer email within 8h, public RCA draft within 6 business days. adjust if needed.

lee: suggested status blurb (short):

```
Incident: Cache eviction cascade (partial)
Impact: Increased 502/504 errors and elevated latency for ~11% of requests between 03:10-03:47 UTC
Mitigation: Rolling cache node replacement and slower eviction policy reduced errors to <1% by 03:36 UTC
Next: RCA in progress; estimated publish: 6 business days
```

gabi: LGTM. For Dedicated customers add a line about direct outreach if they had >5% error rate.

ashley: good point. add: "Dedicated customers impacted above threshold will receive direct notification."

lee: redaction checklist draft for any external comms / RCA: 1) do not include raw request_ids, tokens, or customer API keys; 2) replace IPs and hostnames with anonymized labels; 3) use aggregated counts (no per-account metrics); 4) round timestamps to nearest minute and avoid per-user timestamps; 5) remove or redact stack traces that include customer data; 6) send to legal for final review if any customer-identifying strings appear.

legal: We'll perform a quick PII check but need drafts in docs format. Use the legal scan link and tag @legal. Expect ~48h turnaround for complex redactions.

ashley: ownership matrix (reply with "accept" or :thumbsup: to claim):
- Status page update -> owner -> (assign); ETA -> 2 hours
- Customer email -> owner -> (assign); ETA -> 8 hours
- Public RCA technical doc -> owner -> (assign); ETA -> 6 business days
- Dedicated customer outreach -> owner -> (assign); ETA -> 12 hours
- Long-term remediation plan (cache policy change + backstop) -> owner -> (assign); ETA -> proposal in 12 business days
- Trend retro (check recurrence across last 3 months) -> owner -> (assign); ETA -> schedule within 10 business days

tom: I'll take customer email and coordinate with CS. assigning to @tom. ETA: 8h.

gabi: I'll own status page update and live copy. assigning to @gabi. ETA: 2h.

lee: I'll draft the public RCA technical doc and include recurrence checks. assigning to @lee. ETA: 6 business days.

ashley: who will do dedicated outreach? want a concise, non-technical note flagged to account teams.

gabi: @ashley if you can draft the template, I can help route to accounts. I'll accept the owner role for outreach. assigning to @gabi. ETA: 12h.

ashley: long-term remediation proposal owner? need infra + platform pairing.

no reply (silence)

ashley: I'll pair infra and platform owners and own the remediation proposal if nobody else volunteers. assigning to @ashley. ETA: 12 business days.

status-bot: Incident digest posted to status.redwood.ai  status page update queued by @gabi.

ashley: quick next actions:
- @gabi: publish status page update with ETA copy in 2h and paste link here
- @tom: customer email draft in 8h, post in #customer-success for review
- @lee: public RCA draft in 6 business days; include recurring pattern analysis
- @gabi/@ashley: dedicated outreach template and account routing within 12h
- @ashley: remediation proposal timeline and owners in 12 business days

Please react with :thumbsup: or reply if you need more time. If timelines slip, update this thread and the tracker doc I'll post in ~30m. Closing active assignment phase; will reopen if details change. :white_check_mark:
